title: Oozy French Paccheri Stew
description: A pillowy, brunch‑mood stew inspired by Lyon’s bouillabaisse, featuring paccheri and a gentle vegetable broth cooked in a ttukbaegi.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a ttukbaegi over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion, carrot and celery, sauté until softened about five minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine, deglaze the pan, scraping up browned bits, and let reduce by half.
Add vegetable stock, thyme, bay leaf and fennel seeds, bring to a gentle boil.
Lower the heat, add paccheri and sliced mushrooms, cover and simmer for ten minutes until pasta is al dente.
Stir in cubed tofu, lemon zest and capers, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to low, swirl in a splash of olive oil, and let the stew thicken slightly for two more minutes.
Remove from heat, sprinkle fresh parsley on top, and let rest five minutes before serving.
Ladle into bowl, garnish with extra parsley, and enjoy a pillowy, brunch‑mood stew.
